profile_text.body:
Resemble AI is a company focused on multimodal deepfake detection and AI watermarking, offering enterprise tools to verify whether audio, video, and images are AI-generated or authentic. Its core detection product, DETECT-World, uses a combination of pattern matching and a world model architecture that the company says recognizes deviations from physical reality. The platform is available on-premises or via cloud and is positioned around speed, compliance with AI content standards, and explainability of results. Resemble AI won the T Challenge competition run by T-Mobile US and Deutsche Telsche in 2025.

The company's held facts note that it also offers voice cloning technology, flagged with likeness and consent risk, which sits alongside its detection work. The site frames Resemble AI as bridging AI creation tools and the trust required to use them responsibly, though that framing is the company's own characterization. Much of the contextual material harvested from the site consists of third-party reports about deepfake-related harms, including fraud cases, non-consensual intimate imagery, and impersonation scams, which Resemble AI appears to aggregate as evidence of the problem its detection products address rather than incidents involving the company directly.
